crossRefs.note: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.
How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
When they heard it, they marveled, and left him, and went away.
In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.
No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

translations.web: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
translations.bsb: Job’s friends are dismayed, with no more to say; words have escaped them.
translations.kjv: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
translations.asv: They are amazed, they answer no more: They have not a word to say.
